Our [published robots.txt](https://docs.broadcastwell.com/robots.txt), retained in the 3 November 2026 site snapshot, puts `OAI-SearchBot`, `GPTBot` and `ChatGPT-User` in separate groups, each with `Allow: /`. Reading only the GPTBot group would miss the separately declared search and user-request policies. That is a specific policy record to compare with OpenAI's documented purposes; the file does not show that any of those robots visited or that an answer selected our site.
